def smallestWindow(S, P):
    from collections import Counter
    
    len_s, len_p = len(S), len(P)
    if len_p > len_s:
        return "-1"
    
    p_count = Counter(P)
    s_count = Counter()
    
    start, end = 0, 0
    min_length = float('inf')
    min_start = 0
    required = len(p_count)
    formed = 0
    
    while end < len_s:
        char = S[end]
        s_count[char] += 1
        
        if char in p_count and s_count[char] == p_count[char]:
            formed += 1
        
        while start <= end and formed == required:
            if end - start + 1 < min_length:
                min_length = end - start + 1
                min_start = start
            
            start_char = S[start]
            s_count[start_char] -= 1
            
            if start_char in p_count and s_count[start_char] < p_count[start_char]:
                formed -= 1
            
            start += 1
        
        end += 1
    
    return "-1" if min_length == float('inf') else S[min_start:min_start + min_length]
